work.title: Create a side-effect-free package entrypoint
work.description: Separate the library API from the executable CLI entrypoint: src/index.ts as the package root, src/cli/run-cli.ts exposing the CLI as an explicit function, and src/cli/entry.ts as the only module that invokes it with process.argv, with bin/codepatrol.js pointed at the entry. Today the package root executes the CLI on import, so no consumer can import the library safely.
acceptance: Importing the package root does not execute a command
Importing the package does not write to stdout or stderr
Importing the package does not change process.exitCode
bin/codepatrol.js continues to execute the CLI
The published tarball is tested through the real executable
